speaker: richard_burbage
text: Before we begin. The glass goes here.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Face up, till I must sit. Then it comes off. I'll not break it to please a property, and I'll not sit on it to please a picture.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: That is why it will stay. A question would want an answer, and the answer is a hole behind a curtain. Later. Not before he is carried on.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The plot is on the peg. When you are done with him, Master Will, you are done. Stand at the door if you mean to stand the rest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we begin. Gaunt is carried. The beard is chalk. I have a clove in the side, and I will speak round it.
